test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

You might be wrong, you can’t always be ______.
solution: The correct answer is** 'right.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Right'** is the correct spelling of the word that fits the blank in the sentence. • It is an adjective that means correct or accurate. (शुद्घ, सही; सच) • **Example**: *I was **right**__ about that plan.* • In the sentence, it means that one cannot always be correct or accurate in their beliefs or opinions. • The word **'always'** emphasizes the idea that being right all the time is impossible. • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct answer**: *You might be wrong, you can’t always be **__right__**.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1: **'rite' **is a noun that refers to a religious or ceremonial act or practice. (वर्ग विशेष द्वारा (प्रायः धार्मिक प्रयोजन से) किया गया अनुष्‍ठान) • Option 3: **'write'** is a verb that means to put words on paper or another surface. (लिखना (काग़ज़ पर क़लम या पेंसिल से)) • Option 4:** 'riot'** is a noun that refers to a violent disturbance of the peace by a crowd. (दंगा, बलवा, हंगामा (लोगों द्वारा किसी सार्वजनिक स्‍थान पर, प्रायः विरोधस्‍वरूप)) 192:T99e, The correct answer is **"moves from one hole to another and eats."**
